Title: 1. The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

Title: 2. The Poseidon Adventure
description: A group of passengers must embark on a harrowing struggle for survival after a rogue wave capsizes their cruise ship at sea.

Title: 3. What's Up, Doc?
description: The accidental mix-up of four identical plaid overnight bags leads to a series of increasingly wild and wacky situations.

Title: 4. Last Tango in Paris
description: A young Parisian woman meets a middle-aged American businessman who demands their clandestine relationship be based only on sex.

Title: 5. Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
description: Seven stories are trying to answer the question: what is sex? Or maybe they are not trying.

Title: 6. Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
description: In a futuristic world that has embraced ape slavery, Caesar, the son of the late simians Cornelius and Zira, surfaces after almost twenty years of hiding out from the authorities, and prepares for a slave revolt against humanity.

Title: 7. Joe Kidd
description: An ex-bounty hunter reluctantly helps a wealthy landowner and his henchmen track down a Mexican revolutionary leader.

Title: 8. Pink Floyd: Live at Pompeii
description: British progressive rock band Pink Floyd perform at the ancient Roman Amphitheater in the ruins of Pompeii, Italy in 1971. Although the band perform a typical live set from the era, there is no audience beyond the basic film crew.

Title: 9. Elvis on Tour
description: Concert footage and offstage documentary of singer Elvis Presley.

Title: 10. The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie
description: A surreal, virtually plotless series of dreams centered around six middle-class people and their consistently interrupted attempts to have a meal together.

Title: 11. A Cop
description: After a shaky first heist, a group of thieves plan an even more elaborate and risky second heist.

Title: 12. Cousin Jules
description: An ode to rural France and the simple joys of life, Dominique Benicheti's glorious masterpiece COUSIN JULES captures the daily routine and rituals of Jules, a blacksmith, living with his wife, Felice, on a small farm in the French countryside.

Title: 13. The Seduction of Mimi
description: Forced to leave his family in Sicily, Mimí finds a job in a factory in Turin, where he gets involved in an extramarital affair.

Title: 14. Solaris
description: A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

Title: 15. We Won't Grow Old Together
description: A husband and wife in a loveless marriage struggle to remain ignorant to their failed relationship.

Title: 16. The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant
description: A troubled fashion designer strikes up a romance with a much younger woman.

Title: 17. The Merchant of Four Seasons
description: Hans Epp is a self-destructive man who lives a dissatisfied life. He tries to find meaning as a fruit vendor, but a heart attack impedes his ability to work, which turns his dissatisfaction into despair.

Title: 18. Cesar & Rosalie
description: Cesar is in love with Rosalie. But Rosalie isn't making it easy for him, especially when her old flame enters the picture.

Title: 19. Deliverance
description: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's dammed and turned into a lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a canoeing trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.

Title: 20. Aguirre, the Wrath of God
description: In the 16th century, the ruthless and insane Don Lope de Aguirre leads a Spanish expedition in search of El Dorado.

Title: 21. Cabaret
description: A Kit Kat Klub entertainer in Weimar Republic era Berlin romances two men while the Nazi Party rises to power around them.

Title: 22. Four Dimensions of Greta
description: Hans a young German journalist arrives in London to write an article about au-pair girls, but is requested by friends to investigate the whereabouts of their teenage daughter Greta.

Title: 23. The Last House on the Left
description: Two teenage girls heading to a rock concert for one's birthday try to score marijuana in the city, where they are kidnapped and brutalized by a gang of psychopathic convicts.

Title: 24. Pink Flamingos
description: Notorious Baltimore criminal and underground figure Divine goes up against a sleazy married couple who make a passionate attempt to humiliate her and seize her tabloid-given title as "The Filthiest Person Alive".

Title: 25. Jeremiah Johnson
description: While slowly adapting to the grueling life of a mountain man in the Rocky Mountains, Jeremiah Johnson encounters the Crow and Flathead tribes as well as hunters, trappers and settlers, all of whom call these mountains home.

Title: 26. Sleuth
description: A man who loves games and theater invites his wife's lover to meet him, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.

Title: 27. Slaughterhouse-Five
description: Billy Pilgrim has mysteriously become unstuck in time. He goes on an uncontrollable trip back and forth from his birth in New York to life on a distant planet and back again to the horrors of the 1945 fire-bombing of Dresden.

Title: 28. The Getaway
description: A recently-released ex-con and his loyal wife go on the run after a heist goes awry.

Title: 29. Cries & Whispers
description: When a woman dying of cancer in early twentieth-century Sweden is visited by her two sisters, long-repressed feelings between the siblings rise to the surface.

Title: 30. Fist of Fury
description: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, the star pupil of a recently-deceased martial arts teacher battles a Japanese dojo which seeks the demise of his master's fighting school.

Title: 31. Horror Express
description: Professor Sir Alexander Saxton's obsession with proving a scientific miracle collides with a mind stealing terror aboard a speeding train, where every new victim makes the unseen threat smarter and more dangerous.

Title: 32. Frenzy
description: A serial murderer is strangling women with a necktie. The London police have a suspect, but he is the wrong man.

Title: 33. The Way of the Dragon
description: A country bumpkin martial artist visits his relatives in Rome, Italy, where he must defend them and their restaurant against harassment from brutal gangsters.

Title: 34. Silent Running
description: In a future where all flora are extinct on Earth, an astronaut is given orders to destroy the last of Earth's plant samples, kept in a greenhouse aboard a spacecraft.

Title: 35. Tales from the Crypt
description: Five strangers get lost in a crypt and, after meeting the mysterious Crypt Keeper, receive visions of how they will die.

Title: 36. Roma
description: A fluid, unconnected and sometimes chaotic procession of scenes detailing the various people and events of life in Italy's capital, most of it based on director Federico Fellini's life.

Title: 37. Don't Torture a Duckling
description: When a southern Italian town is rocked by a string of child murders, the police and two urban outcasts search for the culprit amid scapegoating within the superstitious community.

Title: 38. The Mechanic
description: A methodical assassin takes his dead mark's son under his wing, teaching him the craft while hiding a dark secret, only to find his protégé has outmaneuvered him completely.

Title: 39. Female Prisoner Scorpion: Jailhouse 41
description: After spending a year in solitary confinement, Matsu escapes from prison with six more convicts, followed by the guards led by the vengeful warden who wants her dead at all costs.

Title: 40. Fat City
description: Two men, working as professional boxers, come to blows when their careers each begin to take different directions.

Title: 41. The Ruling Class
description: A member of the House of Lords dies, leaving his estate to his son. Unfortunately, his son thinks he is Jesus Christ. Their other, somewhat more respectable family members plot to steal the estate from him; murder and mayhem ensue.

Title: 42. The Devil
description: Young Polish noble Jakub, freed during 1793 Prussian invasion, experiences father's death, betrayal. Traumatized, he follows his savior, committing brutal murders across the country.

Title: 43. Love in the Afternoon
description: Though he has an adoring wife, a bourgeois man is still tempted to pursue other women.

Title: 44. Boxcar Bertha
description: During the Great Depression, a union leader and a young woman become criminals to exact revenge on the management of a railroad.

Title: 45. Fritz the Cat
description: In the late 1960s, a pretentious, womanizing young cat drops out of college, starts a riot in Harlem, hits the road with an ex-girlfriend and gets mixed up with domestic terrorists.

Title: 46. The Harder They Come
description: Wishing to become a successful reggae singer, a young Jamaican man finds himself tied to corrupt record producers and drug pushers.

Title: 47. What?
description: During her Italian vacation, a beautiful young American tourist finds herself a guest in a coastal villa inhabited by some odd people.

Title: 48. The Hot Rock
description: Dortmunder and his pals plan to steal a huge diamond from a museum. But this turns out to be only the first time they have to steal it...

Title: 49. Dracula A.D. 1972
description: In 1972 London - a century after his final battle with Professor Van Helsing - Count Dracula is resurrected by occultist Johnny Alucard, and goes after his archenemy's descendants.

Title: 50. What Have You Done to Solange?
description: A teacher who is having an affair with one of his students is reluctant to present an alibi when his lover witnesses the first in a series of murders connected to their school.

Title: 51. Ulzana's Raid
description: After fierce war chief Ulzana and a small war party jump the reservation bent on murder and terror, an inexperienced young lieutenant is assigned to track him down.

Title: 52. Sisters
description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police that she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

Title: 53. The Cowboys
description: Rancher Wil Andersen is forced to hire inexperienced boys as cowhands in order to get his cattle herd to market on time but the rough drive is full of dangers and a gang of rustlers is trailing them.

Title: 54. Endless Night
description: A working-class young Englishman marries an affable American heiress, but their marital bliss is soon interrupted when they begin constructing a home on land alleged to be cursed.

Title: 55. Images
description: Whilst writing a children's book, a woman is interrupted by images, unsure if they may or may not be real.

Title: 56. Brother Sun, Sister Moon
description: Dramatization of events in the life of St. Francis of Assisi from before his conversion experience through his audience with the pope, including his friendship with St. Clare.

Title: 57. Blacula
description: Los Angeles decorators buy the coffin of an African prince bitten by Dracula centuries before.

Title: 58. Super Fly
description: A drug dealer plans to quit after one final big score, but his supplier will only sell him the amount he needs if he agrees to keep working in the business.

Title: 59. Play It Again, Sam
description: A film critic obsessed with Casablanca (1942) seeks to get over his wife leaving him by dating again with the help of a married couple and his illusory idol, Humphrey Bogart.

Title: 60. Tombs of the Blind Dead
description: Medieval knights executed for their black magic rituals come back as zombies to torment a group of vacationing college kids.

Title: 61. State of Siege
description: Using the interrogation of a US counterinsurgency agent as a backdrop, the film explores the consequences of the struggle between Uruguay's government and the leftist Tupamaro guerrillas.

Title: 62. The Blood Spattered Bride
description: Newlywed Susan is haunted by visions of Mircalla Karnstein, a centuries-old bride who murdered her husband on their wedding night.

Title: 63. Whoever Slew Auntie Roo?
description: An insane and elderly widow lures two unsuspecting orphaned little children inside her mansion in a bizarre twist of the story of Hansel and Gretel.

Title: 64. Bone
description: When a criminal breaks into the Beverly Hills home of a wealthy couple having marital problems, he unwillingly provides the spouses with an unlikely resolution to their conflicts as well as a solution to his own secret problem.

Title: 65. The New Land
description: A Swedish immigrant family struggle to establish a new life for themselves in 1850s Minnesota.

Title: 66. The Murder Mansion
description: A couple lost in thick fog, take refuge in an old mansion next to a cemetery, and strange things start to happen.

Title: 67. Across 110th Street
description: Two New York City cops go after amateur crooks who are trying to rip off the Mafia and start a gang war.

Title: 68. The Big Bird Cage
description: Blossom and Django are thieving mercenaries who engineer a prison break from the outside.

Title: 69. Group Marriage
description: Chris cheats on Sandor with parole officer Dennis. Dennis's ex Jan joins them for dinner. Jan meets Phil at the beach, who then sleeps with Chris. All six live together with lawyer Elaine, facing backlash over their group marriage.

Title: 70. Your Vice Is a Locked Room and Only I Have the Key
description: A string of murders are committed near the estate of a degenerate author, whose abusive relationship with his wife is further complicated by the arrival of his manipulative niece.

Title: 71. The Valachi Papers
description: Gangster Joe Valachi is a marked man in the same joint where mob boss Don Vito Genovese is imprisoned and he's forced to co-operate with the DA in exchange for protection.

Title: 72. Frogs
description: A group of helpless victims celebrate a birthday on an island estate crawling with killer amphibians, birds, insects, and reptiles.

Title: 73. Man of La Mancha
description: The funny story of mad but kind and chivalrous elderly nobleman Don Quixote who, aided by his squire Sancho Panza, fights windmills that are seen as dragons to save prostitute Dulcinea who is seen as a noblewoman.

Title: 74. The Legend of Boggy Creek
description: A documentary-style drama about the "Fouke Monster", a Bigfoot-type creature that has been sighted in and around Fouke, Arkansas since the 1950s.

Title: 75. The Slasher ... Is the Sex Maniac!
description: A serial killer is on the loose. His victims are unfaithful wives and he always leaves compromising photographs at the crime scene.

Title: 76. The Canterbury Tales
description: Pasolini's artistic and always vividly cinematic retelling of eight of Chaucer's famous tales.

Title: 77. The Tall Blond Man with One Black Shoe
description: A hapless orchestra player becomes an unwitting pawn of rival factions within the French secret service after he is chosen as a decoy by being identified as a super secret agent.

Title: 78. Death Line
description: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously, along with a couple who stumble into a victim by accident.

Title: 79. Bad Company
description: A God-fearing Ohio boy dodging the Civil War draft arrives in St. Joseph, MO where he joins up with a hardscrabble group of like runaways heading west

Title: 80. Play It As It Lays
description: A Hollywood actress undergoes a psychic breakdown and recalls the traumatic events which led to her stay at a sanitarium.

Title: 81. Dead Planet
description: Concerned with overpopulation, the government bans pregnancy, under the penalty of death.

Title: 82. Tower of Evil
description: A group of experienced archeologists are searching for an old and mystic Phoenician treasure when they are surprised by a series of mysterious murders...

Title: 83. Avanti!
description: A successful businessman goes to Italy to arrange for the return of his tycoon father's body--and discovers that Dad died with his long-time mistress.

Title: 84. Bawarchi
description: A dysfunctional middle-class family is transformed due to the influence of their new multi-talented household servant - but he might be too good to be true.

Title: 85. Prime Cut
description: A vicious Kansas City slaughterhouse owner and his hick family are having a bloody "beef" with the Chicago crime syndicate over profits from their joint illegal operations. Top enforcer Nick Devlin is sent to straighten things out.
A musical retelling of the American Revolution's political struggle in the Continental Congress to declare independence.

Title: 87. Asylum
description: In order to secure a job at a mental institution, a young psychiatrist must interview four patients inside the asylum.

Title: 88. The Heartbreak Kid
description: A newlywed man on his honeymoon has second thoughts about his marriage and falls for a different woman.

Title: 89. Season of the Witch
description: Joan Mitchell battles isolation, aging fears, and a crumbling marriage as occult forces and personal desires threaten her suburban life through a seductive journey into witchcraft and forbidden freedom.

Title: 90. When Women Lost Their Tails
description: Two tribes of dimwitted cavemen prepare for war against each other.

Title: 91. The Case of the Bloody Iris
description: Having recently escaped the clutches of her ex-husband's sex cult, a beautiful model is stalked by a masked killer whose previous victims include the former occupants of her new apartment.

Title: 92. The Life and Times of Judge Roy Bean
description: In Vinegaroon, Texas, reformed outlaw Roy Bean appoints himself judge for the territory and dispenses his brand of justice as he sees fit.

Title: 93. The Call of the Wild
description: A house dog is abducted and brought to the north as a sled dog.

Title: 94. The Other
description: A series of gruesome accidents plague a small American farming community in the summer of 1935, encircling two identical twin brothers and their family.

Title: 95. Vampire Circus
description: As the plague sweeps the countryside, a quarantined village is visited by a mysterious traveling circus. Soon, young children begin to disappear, and the locals suspect the circus troupe might be hiding a horrifying secret.

Title: 96. Son of Blob
description: A technician brings a frozen specimen of the original Blob back from the North Pole. When his wife accidentally defrosts the thing, it terrorizes the populace, including the local hippies, kittens, and bowlers.

Title: 97. The Stepmother
description: As part of a blackmail plot, a woman is forced to seduce her new husband's son. Complications, including murder, ensue.

Title: 98. Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
description: Alice tumbles into Wonderland, a dream realm filled with peculiar characters like the White Rabbit, March Hare, Queen of Hearts, and Dormouse. As she seeks her way home, she meets strange beings and discovers herself.

Title: 99. Godzilla vs. Gigan
description: After a manga artist and his friends uncover a plot by his employers at an amusement park to lure Ghidorah and Gigan to Earth, Godzilla and Anguirus set out to aid in defeating the invaders.

Title: 100. The Red Queen Kills Seven Times
description: Two sisters inherit their family castle, which is said to be haunted by their ancestor: a raven-haired, red-robed woman who is said to commit seven murders every hundred years.

Title: 101. Dr. Phibes Rises Again
description: The vengeful doctor rises again, seeking the Scrolls of Life in an attempt to resurrect his deceased wife.

Title: 102. All the Way Boys
description: A pair of conniving bush pilots crash-land in the Peruvian jungle, where they come across a community of diamond miners under the thumb of a greedy speculator.

Title: 103. Junior Bonner
description: Ace Bonner returns to Arizona several years after he abandoned his family, Junior Bonner is a wild young man. Against the typical rodeo championship, family drama erupts.

Title: 104. The King of Marvin Gardens
description: A daydreamer convinces his radio personality brother to help fund one of his get-rich-quick schemes.

Title: 105. Climax
description: Monika feels frustrated and misunderstood. The young wife of the busy and successful civil engineer Kai is often alone.

Title: 106. Caliber 9
description: A former gangster is forced to resume his old lifestyle when his violent, jealous ex-colleagues and the police believe that he knows the location of a stolen cache of $300,000.

Title: 107. Lady Sings the Blues
description: The story of the troubled life and career of the legendary Jazz singer, Billie Holiday.

Title: 108. The Outside Man
description: After fulfilling a contract killing in Los Angeles, a French hit man becomes the target of a hit himself and tries to flee back to Paris.

Title: 109. Cut-Throats Nine
description: After bandits attack a wagon transporting prisoners, a sergeant and his daughter must trek through harsh, snow-covered terrain to get seven sadistic convicts to their destination.

Title: 110. The French Sex Murders
description: A weary inspector must solve a brothel murder when the convicted suspect dies and witnesses start turning up dead, but a masked killer threatens to silence everyone, all while the suspect's curse seems to come true.

Title: 111. The Asphyx
description: English country squire Sir Hugo Cunningham searches for immortality by literally 'bottling up' the Spirit of the Dead, or Asphyx.

Title: 112. Straight on Till Morning
description: A timid, withdrawn woman meets a man she believes is finally the love of her life, unaware that he is a vicious serial killer.

Title: 113. Faustine and the Beautiful Summer
description: Faustine who is just 16 years old makes the most of her youth during a beautiful summer when she learns a lot about love.

Title: 114. Sex and the Lonely Woman
description: An unhappily married woman finds love in the arms of an escaped convict, but her sadistic husband and his diabolical friend have other plans in store.

Title: 115. The Amazing Mr. Blunden
description: Two children befriend ghosts in a haunted mansion. To help the ghosts, they make a potion allowing time travel to the past. After becoming housekeepers, they return to the mansion's past and aid the dead children.

Title: 116. Snowball Express
description: When John Baxter inherits a ski resort in the Rocky Mountains, he quits his job in New York and moves west to run it--only to find his "estate" in a state of total dilapidation.

Title: 117. Trouble Man
description: Los Angeles mobsters and police crowd a private eye.

Title: 118. Slaughter
description: Slaughter, a former Green Beret, avenges the killing of loved ones by the Mob, and in so doing is coerced by the Feds into traveling to Mexico to finish off surviving mobsters.

Title: 119. The Cannibal Man
description: A meat factory worker accidentally kills a taxi driver, and begins gradually killing people close to him in order to cover up his original crime. He starts getting rid of the mounting corpses stored in his bedroom through his day job.

Title: 120. Death Walks at Midnight
description: During a drug-fuelled photoshoot, a model witnesses a brutal murder in the apartment opposite hers, and is forced to become an amateur sleuth to unravel the mystery.

Title: 121. A.A.A. Masseuse, Good-Looking, Offers Her Services
description: Young Cristina runs away from home to satisfy her desire for independence and money, much to her father's disappointment. She becomes a call girl, but soon after meeting a pimp called Oskar, some of her new clients meet an untimely demise.

Title: 122. The Man
description: African American senator Douglas Dillman becomes designated survivor of a tragic accident that kills the U. S. President. Eventually, Dillman becomes the first black U. S. President and attempts to end the bigotry standing in his way.

Title: 123. Trick Baby
description: Two Phildelphia con men try to evade gangsters they have conned and cops who are trying to put them in jail.

Title: 124. Sambizanga
description: A man is wrongfully arrested and tortured to death after he is suspected of being part of a revolutionary group.

Title: 125. Slap the Monster on Page One
description: A right-wing newspaper attempts to derail the police investigation of the brutal rape and murder of a young girl to help the candidates it supports in the upcoming elections.

Title: 126. My Childhood
description: The First part of Bill Douglas' influential trilogy harks back to his impoverished upbringing in early-'40s Scotland. Cinema was his only escape - he paid for it with the money he made from returning empty jam jars - and this escape is reflected most closely at this time of his life as an eight-year-old living on the breadline with his half-brother and sick grandmother in a poor mining village.

Title: 127. The Girl on a Broomstick
description: Saxana, a witch-in-training, accidentally stumbles upon a spell that transports her to the human world. She meets Honza who introduces her to the human world, leading to a series of adventures as she experiences life outside magical realm.

Title: 128. What the Peeper Saw
description: A wealthy author's second wife begins to suspect that her 12-year-old stepson may have murdered his mother, who mysteriously died in a bathtub accident.

Title: 129. The Black Tavern
description: A rumor has spread that a retiring corrupt official is traveling with a box filled with all kinds of valuables, and is going to make a stop at a remote inn. And multiple criminal martial artists planning to rob him descend on the tavern.

Title: 130. Propala hramota
description: A Soviet musical-tragicomedy film by Dovzhenko Film Studios in Kyiv. The movie is considered a pearl of Soviet and Ukrainian cinema. The film is based on the novella by Nikolay Gogol.

Title: 131. Los crímenes de Petiot
description: Some deeds done by a German in France during World War II lead to more killings in the present. Are they revenge, or is there another motive? Both civilians and police tries to solve the mystery.

Title: 132. Blue Money
description: Jim seems to have everything: a beautiful wife Lisa, a healthy baby, and a job directing adult films. His perfect life unravels after an affair with an actress and when LA vice police prepare to arrest him.

Title: 133. Au Pair Girls
description: Four sexy foreign girls come to England as au pairs, and quickly become quite intimate with their employers, host families, and everyone else they encounter.

Title: 134. Fear Is the Key
description: A man is in radio contact with his family when their airplane is shot down. He wants to find and punish those responsible and becomes a criminal to get a job as a deep-sea diver with those salvaging the plane's cargo.

Title: 135. Amuck!
description: The secretary of a writer and his wife investigates the disappearance of her lover--their previous secretary--and finds herself the target of the couple's erotic desires and a murder plot.

Title: 136. Sacrifice!
description: In Thailand, a photographer is initiated into a primitive tribe after the chief's daughter falls in love with him, and must help them face modern dangers and a rival clan of cannibals.

Title: 137. The Thing with Two Heads
description: Doctors are forced to transplant the head of terminally ill, arthritic racist surgeon Maxwell Kirshner onto the body of African American Death Row inmate Jack Moss because there is no other donor.

Title: 138. The Candidate
description: Bill McKay is a candidate for the U.S. Senate from California. He has no hope of winning, so he is willing to tweak the establishment.

Title: 139. They're Coming to Get You!
description: A woman recovering from a car accident in which she lost her unborn child finds herself pursued by a coven of devil worshipers.

Title: 140. Indian Summer
description: Daniele, a gambler and poetry professor, takes a teaching job in Rimini. He falls for his 19-year-old student Vanina, who is dating his gambling friend Gerardo. Their affair ends tragically.

Title: 141. Bless This House
description: Neighborhood tensions arise when rambunctious Baines family moves next door to reclusive Abbots, clashing over home distillery and unruly teens while matriarch tries mediating the feud.

Title: 142. Bluebeard
description: A World War I pilot whom everybody envies as a "ladykiller" actually is one. After he beds a woman he's after, he murders her.

Title: 143. Female Prisoner #701: Scorpion
description: After being used and betrayed by the detective she had fallen in love with, young Matsu is sent to a female prison full of sadistic guards and disobedient prisoners.

Title: 144. Carry on Abroad
description: A group of tourists arrive at a half-finished hotel in Spain where the oddly identical staff and bad weather threaten the building's stability.

Title: 145. Chato's Land
description: In 1870s New Mexico, a half-breed kills a bigoted sheriff in self-defense but the posse that eventually hunts him finds itself in dangerous territory.

Title: 146. Ben
description: A lonely boy befriends Ben, the leader of a violent swarm of killer rats.

Title: 147. Child's Play
description: At an exclusive boys' school, a new gym teacher is drawn into a feud between two older instructors, and he discovers that everything at the school is not quite as staid, tranquil and harmless as it seems.

Title: 148. The Pig Keeper's Daughter
description: Moonbeam Swyner, the pigkeeper's curvaceous, sexually-uninhibited daughter, still awaits her Prince Charming. Meanwhile she makes do with a traveling perfume and lingerie salesman. Is the wandering lover boy "The One"?

Title: 149. Requiem for a Vampire
description: Two girls on the run get lost in the French countryside, and wind up in a haunted chateau occupied by an ailing vampire and his servants.

Title: 150. Sixteen
description: A blooming teenage redneck and her naive brother are targeted by a pair of slick carnival performers, who take advantage of her virginity and the family's small fortune gained from a recent land grant.

Title: 151. X, Y & Zee
description: The venomous and amoral wife of a wealthy architect tries, any way she can, to break up the blossoming romance between her husband and his new mistress; a good-natured young widow who holds a dark past.

Title: 152. One-Armed Boxer
description: After his schoolmate and master is killed and he loses an arm, student Tien Lung has to learn the art of one-arm boxing.

Title: 153. Schoolgirl Report Part 3: What Parents Find Unthinkable
description: After the first part of the legendary report dealing with the sexual behavior of underage schoolgirls, and the second part dealing with the psychological background, the third part is devoted to striking individual cases.

Title: 154. Night of the Lepus
description: Giant mutant rabbits terrorize the south-west.

Title: 155. The Genesis Children
description: A group of teen boys go to Rome in this controversial art film.

Title: 156. Sex and the Other Woman
description: A series of vignettes exposing how women manipulate their men into submission.

Title: 157. A Reason to Live, a Reason to Die
description: Branded a coward for surrendering his New Mexico fort to the Confederates without firing a shot, a Union Colonel leads a band of condemned prisoners on a suicide mission to recapture it.

Title: 158. My Dear Killer
description: A mysterious decapitation leads Inspector Peretti into a case of blackmail, deceit, and the unsolved kidnapping of a young girl.

Title: 159. Sounder
description: The oldest son of a loving and strong family of black sharecroppers comes of age in the Depression-era South after his father is imprisoned for stealing food.

Title: 160. Fuzz
description: Detectives at a rundown police precinct in Boston scramble to catch a bomber who's targeting local politicians while trying to extort money from the city.

Title: 161. Treasure Island
description: Young Jim Hawkins has an unforgettable encounter with pirate Captain Long John Silver and his murderous mates.

Title: 162. The New Centurions
description: Family man Roy Fehler joins the L.A.P.D. to make ends meet while finishing law school and is indoctrinated by seasoned veteran Kilvinski. As time goes on, Roy loses his ambitions and family as police work becomes his entire life.

Title: 163. Children Shouldn't Play with Dead Things
description: Six friends in a theatrical troupe dig up a corpse on an abandoned island to use in a mock Satanic rite. It backfires with deadly consequences.

Title: 164. Walter Defends Sarajevo
description: A man who tried to stop Nazi soldiers in World War II.

Title: 165. Man of the East
description: A genteel young Englishman arrives in California, where a trio of his father's old friends must teach him the ways of the West if he is to win the love of a rancher's beautiful daughter.

Title: 166. The Flesh and Blood Show
description: Actors rehearsing a show at a mysterious seaside theater are being killed off by an unknown maniac.

Title: 167. The Grand Duel
description: A grizzled ex-sheriff helps a man framed for murder to confront the powerful trio of brothers who want him dead.

Title: 168. Siddhartha
description: The story of a young Indian who embarks upon a journey to find the meaning of existence. Based on the novel by Hermann Hesse.

Title: 169. Snoopy Come Home

description: Six stories that document the awkward sex lives of Englishmen.

Title: 330. Steptoe & Son
description: Albert Steptoe and his son Harold are junk dealers. Harold meets a stripper, marries her and takes her home. Albert, of course, is furious and tries every trick he knows to drive the new bride from his household.

Title: 331. All's Well
description: Godard examines the structure of movies, relationships and revolutions through the life of a couple in Paris.

Title: 332. Love and Death in the Garden of the Gods
description: An old professor rents a mysterious old villa, and finds a tape recorded by a previous occupant, detailing her debauched lifestyle and the events leading to her murder.

Title: 333. Dealing: Or The Berkeley-to-Boston Forty-Brick Lost-Bag Blues
description: A cocky Harvard graduate transports a load of marijuana from Berkeley to Boston. His girlfriend gets busted with the second load. He and a friend go against a dirty cop and a Cuban gangster to get the load and the girl back.

Title: 334. The Woman Hunt
description: A foreign correspondent is kidnapped and used for human prey.

Title: 335. Pianeta Venere
description: Matteo is a communist intellectual, the son of a wealthy bourgeois, who found himself blind from an eye after the war. One day in the streets of Rome he meets Amelia, a child suffocated by the bourgeois environment.

Title: 336. The Alf Garnett Saga
description: Based on the BBC television series, and a sequel to 'Till Death Us Do Part (1968)', it tells of the family relationship between Alf Garnett, his wife, daughter and son-in-law, all living in a council flat.

Title: 337. Money Money Money
description: A group of gangsters are bored with their usual "sources of income" and decide to be creative in making money with kidnapping celebrities and political figures. Very clever and funny.

Title: 338. Santa and the Ice Cream Bunny
description: Santa Claus finds his sleigh stuck in the sand on a Florida beach only days before Christmas Eve.

Title: 339. A Gorgeous Girl Like Me
description: Young sociologist Stanislas Previne is preparing a thesis on criminal women. He meets Camille Bliss in prison to interview her. Camille is accused of murdering her husband Clovis and her lover Arthur She tells Stanislas about her life and her love affairs..

Title: 340. Alfredo, Alfredo
description: Alfredo, a timid young Italian, lusts after and woos the beautiful Maria Rosa. But when he manages to marry her, he discovers life is not nearly so blissful as he expected.

Title: 341. The Pleasures of a Woman
description: After her uncle dies, young woman visits his hedonistic widow and her aunt by marriage, Martine, who seduces her and shows her the pleasures of the flesh, which unfortunately leads to tragedy.

Title: 343. Cry for Me Billy
description: A drifter falls in love with an Indian girl, with tragic results.

Title: 344. Black Girl
description: An aspiring dancer and her wicked sisters resent their mother's love for a foster daughter.

Title: 345. They Only Kill Their Masters
description: California small town police chief investigates a suspicious death involving the victim's own dog that presumably killed its owner.

Title: 346. Dirty Little Billy
description: A more realistic, based-on-reality, unsensationalistic portrayal of the gritty early years of one of the most famous Wild West outlaws in history, Billy the Kid.

Title: 347. Portnoy's Complaint
description: The movie chronicles a young man's (Richard Benjamin) love and passion in his own kinky way.

Title: 348. The Biscuit Eater
description: In this touching adventure, a remake of the popular 1940 film, two young Georgia boys team up and befriend a feral bird dog, whom they train to participate in a field trials.

Title: 349. Stanley
description: A young Seminole Indian uses his rattlesnake to take revenge on all those he believes have wronged him.

Title: 350. A White Dress for Marialé
description: A woman, who, as a child, witnessed the murder-suicide of her mother and father, invites several friends to her husband's secluded castle. Unbeknownst to them, she has a sinister motive for the invitation.

Title: 351. The Summertime Killer
description: After witnessing his father's murder as a child, a man seeks vengeance against the mafia gang responsible, methodically hunting them down while evading law enforcement and the crime boss.

Title: 352. Garden of the Dead
description: Convicts on a chain gang sniff experimental formaldehyde fumes to get high. They attempt a prison break, are shot down by the guards and buried in the prison garden. Soon, they rise from the dead, using shovels and hoes to kill all who get in their way on their quest to get high once more.

Title: 353. Sensual Classroom: Techniques in Love
description: Tormented by his first sexual stirrings, the teenager Isao dreams every night of his gym teacher Ikuko. He finally opens her heart but she rejects his advances. Frustrated, Isao invents all sorts of strategies to disgust Ikuko's fiance, a professor of chemistry in the same school. As his plan fails, he plans a radical solution.

Title: 354. Fury of the Wolfman
description: A man has had a werewolf curse cast upon him. If he doesn't get rid of it, he turns into a killer werewolf when the moon is full.

Title: 355. National Mechanics
description: A mechanic takes his family to a car race and a series of events occur which brings problems, betrayals, violence and the unexpected death of an elderly person.

Title: 356. Encounter with the Unknown
description: Trilogy of unsettling stories rooted in reality

Title: 357. The Adventures of Barry McKenzie
description: Young Australian, Barry McKenzie, travels to England with his Aunt Edna after his father dies and a request is revealed in his will.

Title: 358. The Abductors
description: Cheerleaders and models are kidnapped & sold by a white slavery ring. Female agent is sent to rescue them.

Title: 359. Naked Girl Murdered in the Park
description: An investigator is assigned to investigate a man's family after he is found dead only hours after taking out a million dollar insurance policy.

Title: 360. Greaser's Palace
description: A strange man named Jesse who can revive life and walk on water comes into a surreal and cruel western town.

Title: 361. When the Legends Die
description: A young, rebellious Ute Indian joins the rodeo circuit and falls in with a drunken mentor who teaches him the ways of the ring and the world.

Title: 362. The War Between Men and Women
description: A sarcastic, near-sighted cartoonist averse to commitment, falls for an eye-catching brunette single mother of three, the only woman who can stand his strong anti-feminist opinions, and eventually moves in with her and proposes.

Title: 363. Frankenstein '80
description: A mad scientist creates a monster called "Mosaico," who breaks out of the laboratory to hunt down and kill beautiful women.

Title: 364. Enter the Devil
description: Somewhere in south west Texas, where a christian cult is said to have resided in the past, a deputy sheriff investigates a number of suspicious deaths.

Title: 365. Deathmaster
description: Quarry is a mysterious, articulate stranger who draws a cult like following of local hippies. Rather than showing them peace and love, he has more sinister plans for them, as he is a vampire.

Title: 366. Piranha
description: Wildlife photographer Terry and her brother Art go to Venezuela for a photo shoot. They hire Jim Pendrake to guide them through the jungle. However, the trio run afoul of evil local hunter Caribe.

Title: 367. The Groundstar Conspiracy
description: A government investigator tries to find out the truth behind the break-in at a top secret research facility.

Title: 368. Night of the Felines
description: Masako is a prostitute who works at a bathhouse in downtown Tokyo. She is sexually involved with her neighbor in the next apartment. However, when his friend falls in love with a young woman this creates a problem for all three of them.

Title: 369. The Naked Seven
description: A gang consisting of seven women roams around the country to steal and resell everything that makes money. When the gang leader falls in love with a samurai and agrees to steal guns for him, he betrays her and soon the women are chased by many enemies.

Title: 370. The Cremators
description: An alien life form that is a huge ball of living matter invades earth, and replenishes itself by absorbing people.

Title: 371. Lovebox
description: Eleven one-act sex comedies, involving wife swappers, a bored housewife, a young virgin, and an orgy in Kilburn.

Title: 372. Koshish
description: A speech and hearing-impaired couple persists through unforgiving obstacles to be accepted by society and live a life of dignity.

Title: 373. Terror at Red Wolf Inn
description: College student Regina wins a getaway vacation at the quiet Red Wolf Inn, which is run by a friendly elderly couple, but it gradually becomes clear that something is amiss.

Title: 374. Molly and Lawless John
description: In New Mexico, a sheriff's unhappy mid-aged wife aids a condemned prisoner escape her husband's jail and elopes with the young and attractive outlaw to Mexico, pursued by the sheriff's posse.

Title: 375. Night of the Cobra Woman
description: After being bitten by a cobra in the Philippines, Lena can turn herself into a snake and she stops aging. The curse comes with a price. The priestess Lena must consume cobra venom and vital young men to stay young.

Title: 376. The Master and Margaret
description: A writer and his assistant are working on a biblical story about Pontius Pilate who convicted Jesus of Nazereth, while the Satan (here called Woland) and his lieutenants are harassing the writer duo in various ways.

Title: 377. Love Me Deadly
description: A young socialite struggling to control her necrophiliac urges is torn between her affection for a kind businessman and the mortician who supplies her with bodies.

Title: 378. The Loners
description: On his motorcycle Stein, a half-blood Indian, tries to stay out of the hands of the police, who are chasing him for accidentally killing a cop. Together with his friend Alan and a beautiful but desperate girl Stein will get involved in a robbery and more death. The police intensify the search, but the three won't give up that easily...

Title: 379. Eye in the Labyrinth
description: A desperate woman traces her vanished psychiatrist lover to a isolated seaside villa, entering a bohemian enclave where hidden crimes, shifting identities, and sudden violence obscure a deadly truth.

Title: 380. Hammersmith Is Out
description: The Faust legend retold (loosely) and applied to a mentally disturbed patient in a hospital run by a doctor (Sir Peter Ustinov) of dubious sanity. The patient (Richard Burton) offers the innocent orderly (Beau Bridges) vast riches if he'll help him escape.

Title: 381. Lady Caroline Lamb
description: A noblewoman doomed to a loveless marriage falls into a scandalous affair with the dashing Lord Byron.

Title: 382. Seeta Aur Geeta
description: Long-suffering heiress Seeta is treated worse than a servant by her abusive money-grubbing aunt. Meanwhile, her long-lost twin sister Geeta grows up to be a gutsy street performer. One day, the girls unintentionally swap places.

Title: 384. Ciao Manhattan
description: This parallels the life of Andy Warhol Factory star Edie Sedgwick. The film chronicles "Susan Superstar's" (Sedgwick) glory days in the late 1960s through her inevitable downfall and the tragic addiction that would claim her life only weeks after filming wrapped in 1971.

Title: 385. The Monk
description: Ambrosio is a monk who is sexually tempted by an emissary of the Devil, a young girl in monk's robes.

Title: 386. Bloody Friday
description: When terrorists rob a bank all hell is let loose.

Title: 387. Scarecrow in a Garden of Cucumbers
description: An aspiring actress from Kansas comes to New York and meets a host of zany characters.

Title: 388. Wild Honey
description: A farm girl runs away from her sexually abusive father and ends up in Los Angeles. Hippies, LSD, prostitution, lesbianism, a threesome, and a meeting with a satanic cult soon follow.

Title: 389. Liza
description: Liza slowly replaces Melampo, Giorgio's dog. While she accepts it, Giorgio forces her to wear collars and leashes.

Title: 390. Pio thermi kai ap' ton ilio
description: The sexual needs of a sensuous, but neglected, married woman drive her to the red light district when her husband is away on business. She seduces and falls in love with a young man, who stalks her when she tries to break up their affair.

Title: 391. The Mind Snatchers
description: A German scientist works on a way of quelling overly aggressive soldiers by developing implants that directly stimulate the pleasure centers of the brain.

Title: 392. Full Time Females
description: Stéfanie, nursing an old man in a nice country villa, has been killed by young men; they will try to replace her with a double; when she finally gets suspicious they plan to kill her too.

Title: 393. Last of the Red Hot Lovers
description: A restaurant owner explores his wanderlust by visiting his mother's empty apartment weekly, discovering that his attempts at romantic pursuits are far more challenging than anticipated.

Title: 394. Invasion of the Blood Farmers
description: Somewhere in upstate New York, a secretive group of farmers are harvesting human blood for a mysterious purpose.

Title: 395. Something Wicked This Way Comes
description: Strange things start to happen when Mr Dark's Pandemonium Carnival arrives in Greentown.

Title: 396. Tintin and the Lake of Sharks
description: Tintin and his friends visit Professor Calculus at his country laboratory, only to find him and a pair of local children threatened by criminals after the inventor's work.

Title: 397. An American Hippie in Israel
description: Four individuals, seeking freedom, embark on an isolated island journey. When their boat drifts and supplies dwindle, primal instincts emerge, culminating in a catastrophic conclusion as they descend into survival mode.

Title: 398. Red Psalm
description: Set in the 1890s on the Hungarian plains, a group of farm workers go on strike in-which they face harsh reprisals and the reality of revolt, oppression, morality and violence.

Title: 399. Penthouse Playgirls
description: A gang of white slavers lure beautiful young women into prostitution by staging beauty contests in which the "prize" is a Hollywood contract. The "winners" are then drugged and sold to international sex traffickers.

Title: 400. Night of 1000 Cats
description: A wealthy playboy kidnaps and murders young women, feeding their corpses to his horde of felines.

Title: 401. Wedding in White
description: A father will do anything to protect his family's reputation when his unmarried teenage daughter becomes pregnant because she was raped by her brother's friend.

Title: 402. Gefährlicher Sex frühreifer Mädchen 2: Höllisch heiße Mädchen
description: The young Eva breaks out of her petty-bourgeois home in the Bavarian province and experiences a "bed career".

Title: 403. The Goalie's Anxiety at the Penalty Kick
description: Goalkeeper Josef Bloch is ejected during a game for foul play. He leaves the field and goes to spend the night with a cinema cashier.

Title: 404. Glass Houses
description: Teenage Kim is in love with her father, Victor, a middle class L.A. businessman who's sleeping with her peer, Jean, while Victor's wife is sleeping with a local novelist. Kim seduces Victor's business partner, Ted, to get to Victor.

Title: 405. Superstar Goofy
description: Goofy participates in several Olympic events and generates several disorders.

Title: 406. The Water Margin
description: Sometime during the Song Dynasty, a band of martial artists form a private army to fight corruption. After trying to recruit two wealthy kung fu masters, one is arrested and sentenced to death, and the other seeks their help for a rescue.

Title: 407. Jangal Mein Mangal
description: Biology Professor Laxmi, in the company of nine of her students, and a convent nun, Sophia, go on a field trip in Kerala, Southern India. Upon arrival, they decide to stay there at a Public Rooming House, which also happens to house another group of students, this time all male, headed by Retired Colonel M.K. Das. After several misunderstandings both the groups compromise and decide to pass the rest of their temporary stay in peace. But fate has other plans for them, for Sophia is killed, apparently murdered by a zombie-like creature, dressed in black, who lives in a nearby grave-yard. Before the police and the others could react, a male student is killed. Three male students do encounter this creature, but it manages to over-power all three, and no amount of force or bullets can stop it. It's main motive seems to kill anyone who stands in it's way, including the police!

Title: 408. Nurses Report
description: At the St. Martin hospital in Munich the nurses are underpaid and overworked. The only variety is having sex.

Title: 409. Neither the Sea Nor the Sand
description: Wife on Isle of Jersey, meets lighthouse keeper they become lovers. Flee to Scotland. lighthouse keeper dies. Incident triggers further events.

Title: 410. Le Sex Shop
description: The owner of a book shop in Paris suffers a personal crisis. In order to solve it he decides to convert his library into a sex shop, but the only effect is that he turns himself into a sexual obsessive.

Title: 411. Ben and Charlie
description: When, after serving a three-year sentence, Ben Bellow is released from prison, Charlie Logan is waiting for him. Not to hug him. Not to welcome him. Just to let him know, a bit bluntly for sure, that he does not want to hear from him again. His wish will not be granted as the the two sworn enemies constantly reconnect, rob a bank together and go through a million adventures while hating each other's guts...

Title: 412. Cool Breeze
description: Thalmus is the leader for a group of criminals who gather in L.A. to rob a bank. Their goal is to find a new bank.

Title: 413. Shor
description: Shankar a mill worker lives happily with wife Geeta and son Deepak.An accident kills Geeta and damages Deepak's vocal chords.Shankar can't afford the cost of Deepak's surgery but is determined that someday Deepak will start talking.

Title: 414. Savages
description: An allegory about humankind progresses from a savage state to a civilized form, that is only a cover for its innate barbarism.

Title: 415. Bangarada Manushya
description: Rajeeva comes to the village to visit his sister only to find that she's in financial trouble and has lost her husband. He decides to stay and help her out.

Title: 416. Bombay to Goa
description: College student Mala has dreams of becoming a Bollywood movie actress; her dreams began materializing into reality when she is approached by Mr. Sharma and his assistant Mr. Verma who promises to take her to the way of stardom. Unfortunately when her parents learn about this they oppose to this and decide to arrange her marriage so that she will be restricted to go above her limits forcing her to approach Sharma for advice who asks her to run-away with huge sums of cash. Greed over comes the duo resulting in Sharma killing Verma; Mala who witness this is on the run for her life; she then board a bus that run between Bombay to Goa without realizing where this journey will end. But her life remains threaten as Sharma has not given up his searches for her.

Title: 417. The Triple Echo
description: During World War II, a deserting soldier dresses as a woman to escape detection, hiding at a farm run by a POW's wife, but is soon hit-on by a lusty sergeant.

Title: 418. Black Gunn
description: A black militant group robs a Mafia bookie joint and also steals the incriminating ledgers which, in turn, prompts retaliation from the mob.

Title: 419. Der Stoff aus dem die Träume sind
description: In search of a hot story, investigative journalist Walter Roland and photographer Bertie Engelhardt get into contact with two young defectors from the CSSR. When one of the two refugees is shot, Walter and Bertie try to uncover the motives behind the crime. However, by doing so, they soon get into mortal danger themselves because as it turns out, several secret services, including the CIA and the BND, are involved in the affair - and they are not interested in publicity.

Title: 420. Lady Kung Fu
description: Three graduated Hapkido students return to China from Japanese-occupied Korea in order to set up their own school. However, problems start to arise when a local Japanese martial arts school tries to run the new school out of town.

Title: 421. The Boxer from Shantung
description: Leaving the poverty of his life in Shantung to seek a better one in Shanghai, a lowly martial artist is inspired by another kung fu master who moved to Shanghai and became a highly respected gangster, so he follows in his footsteps.

Title: 422. Ecstasy of the Angels
description: A revolutionary faction steals some hand bombs. While escaping, several soldiers are killed. The movement's highest authority deems October unfit and sends the leader of another faction to take the remaining bombs.

Title: 423. The Chastity Belt
description: Queen of England gives birth to twins, one kept in a pig sty, and the other hidden. Lurkalot, raised by pigs, fights to protect his daughter and her royal line.

Title: 424. Sex Charade
description: The story revolves around Anne who is held hostage by an escaped maniac from an insane asylum. The fugitive forces her to tell stories to prevent her from getting help. Anne then spins a fanciful tale about a girl's escape from her imprisonment by savages and her longing to return to captivity.

Title: 425. Wrong Way
description: Two girls are driving home when their car breaks down in the country. They are kidnapped by a gang of drug-crazed hippies, and repeatedly raped. They escape, but soon run into a death cult who plan to gang-rape the girls, then kill them. Meanwhile, the father of one of the girls gets the police to begin an investigation into their disappearance.

Title: 426. The Crimes of the Black Cat
description: A blind pianist overhears a conversation in a nightclub, and is determined to figure out who is responsible for a string of strange murders involving a black cat.

Title: 427. Malcolm X
description: James Earl Jones narrates this fascinating and moving documentary about the life of the assassinated black leader through various sources.

Title: 428. Ludwig - Requiem for a Virgin King
description: The story of the legendary King Ludwig II of Bavaria (1845-1886), his opera interest and friendship with theatre personalities such as Richard Wagner and Joseph Kainz, and at the same time a reflection of the German 1800s.

Title: 429. Avoir 20 ans dans les Aurès
description: In 1961, Noël is a French soldier in the Algerian war. His comrades, formerly opposed to the war, now oppress civilians, kill and torture. To stay faithful to his pacifist values, he will do something radical.

Title: 430. VD
description: Cornelis van Doorn is the boss of the family business VD, a factory for meat and contraceptives. Cornelis is also the godfather of the strange company of the Van Doorn family: abuse of power, illegitimate children, semi-incest, manslaughter, abortion, promiscuity, unethical commerce and all other kinds of degeneration and decadence. When the old gentleman has a burned out, the new generation takes over the torch on the basis of the proven VD code.

Title: 431. Yakuza Wolf: I Perform Murder
description: The son of a murder crime boss exacts his revenge by pitting two rival clans against each other.

Title: 432. A Day in the Death of Joe Egg
description: A couple uses extremely black comedy to survive taking care of a daughter who is nearly completely brain-dead. They take turns doing the daughter's voice and stare into the eyes of death and emotional trauma with a humor that hides their pain.

Title: 433. Tout le monde il est beau, tout le monde il est gentil
description: According to "Radio closer to God", nothing is conceived without God, especially shampoos, cosmetics, the sale of records - Animator Christian Gerber denounces this scam on the air, which is worth licensee. It will reappear on new weaves with "Radio closer to the truth."

Title: 434. The Twilight People
description: A kidnapped diver is taken to an island inhabited by a mad scientist and his half-animal, half-human creations.

Title: 435. The Sicilian Connection
description: An American underworld up-and-comer relocates to Europe and immerses himself in the dangerous and mysterious world of heroin production.

Title: 436. Arcana
description: A Sicilian widow earns her living as a clairvoyant, in Milan, but she hasn't got any power at all. Her son instead holds supernatural powers and with the help of his mother he becomes a strong sorcerer. But he fails perhaps to understand the real strength he possesses inside and unbinds uncontrolled forces that lead people that surround him to go mad.

Title: 437. Miss Julie
description: A televised Royal Shakespeare Company production of August Strindberg's classic play. Miss Julie (Dame Helen Mirren), a nineteenth century aristocrat's daughter, is attracted to one of the servants in her father's house.

Title: 438. Felix si Otilia
description: A large family and it's many generations vie for advantage, seeking to win the inheritance sure to be left behind by a wealthy older man of the clan. Along the way, stories of friendship, love and rivalry emerge.

Title: 439. Smil mand!
description: Teenage Ole is sent to boarding school by his single mother so he can learn more about life as he goes through puberty. But he finds the other boys just have their own problems.

Title: 440. Under the Flag of the Rising Sun
description: One woman's search to find the truth about her husband's death in World War II.

Title: 441. Winter Soldier
description: Vietnam vets testify in Detroit 1971 about war atrocities they committed or saw. Officers approved routine brutality, false body counts, village destruction. Veterans discuss racism. Testimony enters Congressional Record.

Title: 442. Tokugawa Sex Ban
description: Kiyohime, a daughter of Tokugawa Ienari is married-off to Tadateru Ogura, the lord of a Kyushu clan. However, the lord's sexual inexperience and Kiyohime's strict morals lead to significant crisis in their marriage. To improve his sexual prowess, the lord is introduced to Sandra, a French woman held captive by usurer-smuggler Hatakaya. This results in the lord's choosing Sandra as his mistress. Kiyohime's attendants see this move as an insult and have Sandra beaten and imprisoned. Nevertheless, Sandra escapes with the help of Morita, a retainer of the lord. Out of bitterness and as some sort of revenge, the lord imposes a sex ban on his subjects.

Title: 443. Mutiny on the Buses
description: London bus driver Stan Butler wants to get married and takes his chance to earn more money when he is given a new job driving a tour bus on a safari park.

Title: 444. The Mummies of Guanajuato
description: The Mummy of the legendary wrestler Satan awakes 100 years after his death, as Satan was also a powerful sorcerer who vowed to take revenge over the City of Guanajuato before dying.

Title: 445. Lady Whirlwind
description: A young female martial artist reluctantly decides to help a man who is being pursued by a vicious gang, so that she would have the pleasure of killing him herself as revenge for causing the death of her sister.

Title: 446. Pancho Villa
description: A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

Title: 447. L'Amour
description: Donna and Jane are two American hippies, searching for sex and romance in Paris but, mainly, rich husbands. Eventually, Donna finds a perfume industrialist, Michael, who wishes to marry her, providing she will accept sharing his special friendship with local gigolo Max. Drama ensues as Michael changes his mind when meeting Jane, but all is well that ends well.

Title: 448. Poor Albert & Little Annie
description: Albert tried to kill his rich snobby mother once. Then he was institutionalized. Now he's escaped. Albert is after his mother again. And he will torture and kill anything that lays in the way...

Title: 449. Chung Kuo: China
description: A documentary on China, concentrating mainly on the faces of the people, filmed in the areas they were allowed to visit. The 220-minute version consists of three parts. The first part, taken around Beijing, includes a cotton factory, older sections of the city, and a clinic where a Caesarean operation is performed using acupuncture. The middle part visits the Red Flag canal and a collective farm in Henan, as well as the old city of Suzhou. The final part shows the port and industries of Shanghai and ends with a stage presentation by Chinese acrobats.

Title: 450. Beware My Brethren
description: A religious sect called the Brethren has taken control of widow Birdy, sending her unstable son, Kenny, into a spiraling descent into madness. No woman is safe when Kenny's religious mania overpowers him and leads to murder and chaos.

Title: 451. Lehrmädchen-Report
description: In seven episodes, the sexual adventures of highly sexy schoolgirls are dramatically presented in their workplace.

Title: 452. White Sister
description: A nun falls in love with her patient, who happens to be a communist.

Title: 453. Red Hot Zorro
description: A soft-core sex farce using the Zorro legend as an excuse for countless lusty exploits. Jean-Michel Dhermay is the dashing and amorous Zorro who stands up agaunst the tyrannical California governor (Ghislaine Kay). And lays down against a lot of beautiful women.

Title: 454. Sonny & Jed
description: A vulgar, womanizing social bandit reluctantly takes on a tomboyish would-be outlaw as his partner in crime and love, all while the duo is pursued by a vengeful sheriff and bounty hunters.

Title: 455. Forbidden Decameron
description: The young Ferruccio, after departing from Florence to bring a message to Abbot Gianni, welcomes the invitation to enter a convent and become a friar.

Title: 456. Rivals
description: Peter runs a New York tour. Christine is a recently widowed art gallery owner, and she falls in love with him. But, her 10-year-old son loves her way too much and has an unhealthy and pathological attachment to his mother.

Title: 457. The Brides Wore Blood
description: "The Brides Wore Blood" is a 1972 horror movie - The DeLorca family has been cursed ever since Carlos' grandfather was interrupted while conjuring evil spirits. The curse makes each DeLorca son turn into a vampire.

Title: 458. The Real Decameron
description: The squire John Attelano is eager to put his son Falcotto on track, makes him marry Firdalba, the Rampaldi daughter. The newlyweds will receive 15,000 florins on condition that she reaches the altar a virgin.

Title: 459. Love Times Three
description: A mother and daughter share the same lover.

Title: 460. How Far, How Near
description: Middle-aged Andrzej takes a dreamlike journey to his troubled past, trying to understand his friend's suicide.

Title: 461. Ruslan and Ludmila
description: In the midst of the wedding party of Prince Ruslan and Ludmila, the daughter of Prince Vladimir is kidnapped by the evil sorcerer Chernomor and the witch Naina. Three former suitors for her hand set out, as does Ruslan, to rescue Ludmila.

Title: 462. Camorra
description: The fast career of a young Neapolitan among contraband, gambling dens, bribes and illegality. He will upgrade its rank till the maximum level of the "Family".

Title: 463. Miss Leslie's Dolls
description: A young college professor and three of her students seek shelter during a storm in the rural farmhouse of a strange woman who collects lifelike mannequins.

Title: 464. Asylum of Satan
description: A young woman is brought to an asylum against her will to receive special treatment from a mysterious doctor. Dr. Jason Specter does more than just run the asylum, however -- he offers up his patients as human sacrifices to Satan himself.

Title: 465. The Salzburg Connection
description: A list of agents and collaborators, hidden by the Nazis in an Austrian lake in 1945, is sought after by various interested parties during the Cold War.

Title: 466. Come Back Charleston Blue
description: Sequel to Cotton comes to Harlem. Another bad influence is hitting Harlem and Gravedigger and Coffin Ed are the two cops who will stop it. Charleston Blue was a prohibition era black gangster, dead 4 decades. When he seems to have reappeared, once again slitting throats with his Blue straight edge razors, the two cops begin a complicated search for some answers.

Title: 467. To Find a Man
description: The platonic friendship between two high school youths is explored through the attempts to get the girl an abortion. Her young male friend offers his support and tries to find her a doctor. She is grateful, but has trouble in expressing her thanks. At times funny, at other times touching, this is a refreshing, uncommon look at teenage friendship.

Title: 468. Where Does It Hurt?
description: A corrupt hospital administrator decides to get as much money as possible from the patients by any means necessary--by lying, cheating, or stealing.

Title: 469. Corky
description: A country boy wants to make it big as a stockcar racer.

Title: 470. Dushmun

Title: 717. Ek Nazar
description: Directed by B.R. Ishara, Ek Nazar is a poignant romantic drama that showcases the complexities of love, ambition, and sacrifice. Featuring the charismatic pair of Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bhaduri (later Jaya Bachchan), this film is a compelling watch for fans of classic Bollywood cinema. Plot Overview The story revolves around Rajesh (Amitabh Bachchan), a poet who finds himself captivated by Shabnam (Jaya Bhaduri), a courtesan with an enigmatic personality and a haunting past. Their relationship blossoms despite societal norms and their personal struggles. The film delves into themes of redemption, societal hypocrisy, and the power of love to transcend barriers. Performances Amitabh Bachchan, in one of his earlier roles, delivers a restrained and heartfelt performance as Rajesh. His portrayal of a tortured poet is convincing, hinting at the superstar he would later become. Jaya Bhaduri shines as Shabnam, bringing depth and vulnerability to her character. Her nuanced expressions and understated acting style perfectly complement Bachchan's intensity. Music The soulful music by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, combined with lyrics by Majrooh Sultanpuri, is one of the film's highlights. Songs like "Patta Patta Boota Boota" (sung by Lata Mangeshkar and Mohammed Rafi) remain timeless, beautifully reflecting the film's melancholic and romantic undertones. Overall, Ek Nazar is a classic that highlights the magic of early Bollywood romance with a touch of social commentary. The film is an ode to love's transformative power and the sacrifices it demands. While it may not be fast-paced, its poetic storytelling and soulful music make it a memorable experience for fans of vintage cinema.

description: In Lazio, four young people named Riccetto, Girasole, Lallo and Tombarolo try to make a living by stealing what they find in the tombs of the rich buried. Being inexperienced, they often find themselves in trouble or pursued by the police.

Title: 727. Voluptuous Vixens
description: At the girls' school, the young teacher requests the young women to prepare a lecture on the topic "The Preliminaries", for next week, before the year's end. The girls would contact him if they had any problems with their work. Thus a series of sexual experiments start, which will involve the whole class, and even the teacher.

Title: 728. Porno no teiô: Shisshin toruko furo
description: Umemiya stars as a sexist son-of-a-bitch yakuza involved with the sex business.

Title: 729. Parades
description: Set in fictitious Fort Nix this drama presents, through a strong anti-military message, the supposed abuses that go on inside the United States military stockades as it tells the prisoners' tales.

Title: 730. Reminiscences of a Journey to Lithuania
description: Filmmaker Jonas Mekas creates an elegiac diary of a trip to his home country of Lithuania.

Title: 731. Born to Boogie
description: Documentary about T. Rex includes concert footage and staged sequences. Sir Ringo Starr's directorial work is mindful of touches used on Magical Mystery Tour (1967).

Title: 732. Karzan, il favoloso uomo della jungla
description: An expedition, financed by Lord Carter and led by Captain Fox, have as a goal to find and capture a jungle-man who lives in Africa.

Title: 733. Ek Bar Mooskura Do
description: Childhood friends Dilip and rich businessman Ashok take different paths. Dilip loves Mala but must improve his status to marry her. After working hard for success, he returns to find Mala has married Ashok.

Title: 734. The Hoax
description: Two scheming ne'er-do-wells find a lost nuclear weapon in the ocean near Los Angeles. They decide to light-heartedly try to blackmail the city by asking for money from each citizen, which arouses the local authorities' attention.

Title: 735. Havoc
description: Pollution, disaffection, moral decay and social unrest surround a church and its pastor's family heading toward a celebration over the return of its bells.

Title: 736. While the Cat's Away...
description: Mrs. Jones is a suburban housewife with nine different lovers. Lurch, a reporter is assigned to get the scoop on it.

Title: 737. Company Party
description: The office of Levin's PR agency be decorated for the company party. The staff retiring for the day of giggly mood and goes home to get changed for the evening's other pleasures.

Title: 738. Georgia, Georgia
description: When an African-American singer travels to Stockholm, Sweden to perform, she meets an American deserter and they fall in love, but her friend and assistant Alberta warns her to stick to her own kind.

Title: 739. Kalimán, el hombre increíble
description: Kaliman becomes involved in the rescue of the last descendant of the Pharaohs of Egypt.

Title: 740. Hymn
description: The story tells of the adoration of Sasuke for his mistress, the blind Shamisen teacher Shunkin, who treats him imperiously and subjects him to cruel beatings.

Title: 741. Beyond the Frontiers of Hate
description: A family of pioneers is almost completely destroyed by Indians in search of revenge: Little George was left fainted on the ground, and his small sister adopted by the Indian chief. Fate will bring them together again.

Title: 743. Olsen-banden tar gull
description: Egon returns from prison with the key to a big heist, a hidden Nazi-treasure. After some trouble, the Olsen Gang finds the place, but problems are still topped when the international criminals Carina and Ricco turns up.

Title: 744. Chronicle of a Homicide
description: During a clash between demonstrating laborers, a policeman and a student are both killed. In charge of the case are a magistrate and two commissioners.

Title: 745. Bounty Hunter 3: Eight Men to Kill
description: This is the third and final chapter of the Shokin Kasegi (Bounty Hunter) series starring the great Wakayama Tomisaburo as a doctor who doubles as a bounty hunter with a vast array of weapons and the greatest sword skill in the land.

Title: 746. El primer año
description: In 1970, Salvador Allende came to power in Chile as the first socialist president. In his first year in office, Patricio Guzmán films the consequences of this political earthquake and its impact on the population. Allende nationalizes the mines in defiance of their very wealthy owners; his supporters are delighted, but the stock market plummets and the wealthy upper class leaves the country. Guzmán takes to the road for his first feature-length documentary: interviewing original owners who demand their land back, and miners, fishermen and factory workers who talk forthrightly about their working conditions, and shows the renewed hope for a better life. The First Year was the first part in a trilogy (with October's Response and The Battle of Chile) about Allende's government, ending with the 1973 coup. Guzmán shot the film on a very modest budget, on 16mm without synchronous sound. His unique recordings shot from close by reach a climax with footage of the visit of the Cuban leader Fidel Castro, whom we see casually chatting, and of the enthusiastic reactions of the Chileans who flock to see him.

Title: 747. Tarkan: Altin Madalyon
description: The story of Tarkan and his friends efforts to rescue Atilla's kidnapped son.

Title: 748. Zameen Aasmaan
description: Disciplinarian Shanti Swaroop (Ashok Kumar) alienates himself from his wife Urmilla (Indrani Mukherjee); son, Ravi (Sunil Dutt), and daughter, Roopa (Yogeeta Bali). His wife passes away, and he marries another woman, Maya (also Indrani Mukherjee), who looks like his wife. Maya has an on-going affair with Heeralal "Heera" (Ramesh Deo) unknown to Shanti Swaroop. A fall from a staircase makes Shanti Swaroop lose his eyesight, and makes him totally dependent on his wife, and a nurse, Kalpana (Rekha). Blinded and unable to see reason clearly, he refuses to let his daughter marry Ram (Sharad) as he is poor; and asks Ravi to leave his house, when Ravi speaks out against Heera and Maya, thus leaving the ground wide open for them to attempt to initially permanently blind him, and then blame the nurse for this negligence.

Title: 749. Sanjog
description: Mohan and Asha are in love and eventually marry in a private temple much against Mohan's parents' wishes. Mohan goes out of town for some months. Upon his return his parents lies to him that Asha is died. Mohan marries Seema and has two children. Mohan is employed with the local municipality. After 10 years Asha takes over as collector and Mohan's boss. Asha helps Mohan and his family in best possible ways and wants the truth to never come out. However, rumors start to circulate about Mohan and Asha. Seema at first disregards these rumors but later comes to know the truth. She decides to end her life but Asha saves her and loses hers' in the process.

Title: 750. Queen Doll
description: A man grows obssessed with his erstwhile childhood sweetheart and it leads to a haunting encounter with horror.

Title: 751. Marco Polo Jr.
description: Marco Polo Jr., the descendant of the legendary explorer, goes on a daring journey in search of his own destiny.

Title: 752. Valeria dentro e fuori
description: A young, frustrated woman is married to a famous choreographer. She has everything she wants except for one thing: her husband refuses to have sex with her.

Title: 753. Ettore lo fusto
description: What must Cardinal Giove do to acquire land on which stands a prestigious brothel?

Title: 754. Mome Ki Gudiya
description: Ravi, the only son of wealthy widower Rai Bahadur Gangaram, falls in love with fellow-collegian, Sheel, but is shocked to find that she is to be his future step-mother. His father decides to step away, lets the couple get married, and shortly thereafter passes away. A few months later, Sheel gets pregnant and her parents as well as her maternal uncle, Salikram, come to visit her. It is during this visit that Ravi will find out that Sheel has been living a secret life, and the real reason why she married him. Devastated, he will face even more trauma and scandal when the Police will arrest his wife for murder.

Title: 755. The Strange Vengeance of Rosalie
description: A traveling salesman gives a pretty female hitchhiker a ride to her home, a run-down shack in the desert. She then injures his leg in order to hold him captive.

Title: 756. Tabi no omosa
description: A 16-year-old girl grows into maturity while hiking the 88-temple pilgrimage around Shikoku.

Title: 757. Grazie signore p...
description: Marco is traumatized by the fact that his mother, a widow and still young, goes from one man to another with extreme ease. This is why he rejects the approaches of Anna and Eva, two uninhibited Milanese women who have their eyes on him. But girls know better than the devil.

Title: 758. Kara Murat: Fatih'in Fedaisi
description: Mehmed the Conqueror sends Kara Murat to stop Prince of Wallachia, Vlad the Impaler aka Vlad III Dracula, the historical inspiration for the vampire Count Dracula.

Title: 759. Der Dritte
description: A disillusioned single mother decides to give love one last chance.

Title: 760. Return of Halleluja
description: Hallelujah is hired by an incompetent Mexican revolutionary to recover a lost Aztec idol, with which he will be able to elicit the help of the native tribes in his hapless uprising. However, such a powerful symbol has it's attractions for a wide range of other individuals.

Title: 761. Bounty Hunter in Trinity
description: The townsfolk of Trinity decide to hire a notorious bounty hunter to protect them from a fierce band of Mexican outlaws who are terrorizing the area. He discovers the true person behind the bandits is within the town. A bloody gunfight ends the control of the gang and returns control of the town to its people.

Title: 762. The Black Decameron
description: The endless search for pleasure and love by African men and women.

Title: 763. Goryachiy sneg
description: In November, 1942, near the Volga, Stanlingrad is under siege of Commander Friederich Paulus and his 330,000 men. The Soviet high command unleashes an operation to protect the Mishkova River to avoid that about four hundred tanks join Paulus' army. The Soviet artillery soldiers protect their position with their lives in a bloodshed with few survivors.

Title: 764. Sweet Talker
description: Traditional love story of a ladies' man falling for an ingenue from the village and discovering what true love is.

Title: 765. His Name Was Holy Ghost
